Channel L — Distribution & Brands

Audio & instruments, factory-direct since 1998.

Art Music distributes professional audio and musical instruments — and designs its own — holding stock in Italy and moving it through distribution centres across Italy, Central & South America and the Caribbean, with OEM builds for customers worldwide.

Distribution · Manufacturing · OEM & proprietary brands
Markets: Italy · Central America · South America · Caribbean
AMP
Speakers · Mixers · Commercial audio

Acoustic speakers, mixers, portable audio and accessories — mic cables, stands and supports — plus commercial audio for conference rooms and hospitals.

MITIKA
Microphone stands

Innovative mic stands in aluminium and iron — distinctive because they lock without a single screw or nail on the moving parts.

GUITARS HILL
Classical · Acoustic · Tres

Classical and acoustic guitars, the Cuban tres, and accessories for acoustic instruments — cables and strings included.

BREDAMHILL
Amps · Bass · Electric piano

Guitar amplifiers, bass and electric pianos — available in transistor or valve configurations for stage and studio.

SEELAKE
Software · AudioStation

AudioStation — a powerful, versatile player for VST instruments and effects, and the group's move into software.

Channel R — Art Music Studio

A studio you can move into.

A full recording studio built for everything from a solo voice to a large ensemble — with a live room that splits in two, four booths, and the option to stay on site and keep the session going.

Recording

Live, direct-to-desk tracking

Mixing

On a 40-channel analogue desk

Mastering

Analogue + Pro Tools HD hybrid

Live streaming

Full live-event production

Sala presa — the live room: full band on the drum floor, grand piano & Hammond in the tracking room beyond

The backline — a deep collection of amps and instruments on hand for any session

The rooms
Sala presa — main live room

Divides into two distinct spaces and, with four booths for voices and instruments, captures large ensembles live. Wide glass keeps players in eye contact while staying acoustically isolated.

Sala prove — rehearsal room

Fully equipped with vocal PA, drums and amps, with its own independent entrance for maximum flexibility.

Stay & the rest of the house

The session doesn't stop at the control-room door.

Right above the studios, the group runs its own guest house — so artists can track late, sleep upstairs and be back at the desk in the morning.

La Distilleria & Smokehouse

A second production room, La Distilleria, sits inside the same complex — and above it all, the Smokehouse BBQ & grill, serving certified, responsibly-sourced meat between takes.

Two audiences. One house they can trust.

Dealers and artists want different things — but the credibility of the brands and the credibility of the room reinforce each other. The umbrella keeps each world in its own voice while letting them share one reputation and one address.
